messages:
marta: Hey team, customer reports 429s for project proj_42 even though the project quota tile shows ~70% used. They hit this during a steady burst around 15:03 UTC.
aj: Can you paste example request ids + any normalized timestamps? We need to correlate with metering logs.
marta: req=01H7Z9XQ-abc123, project=proj_42, org=org_acme, user reports X-RateLimit headers: X-RateLimit-Limit: 120000, X-RateLimit-Remaining: 1245, but API returned 429 with body "org capacity exhausted".
sam: Hmm org pool enforcement message means the org-level rolling window probably exceeded. Dashboard shows org pool at 60% though? That's odd.
quota-bot: Automated check: org_acme pool usage (1m rolling): 118,500 tokens; pooled limit: 120,000; short window spike between 15:02:50-15:03:10.
linda: Found a matching entry in the metering ledger: shard=shard-7, window_floor=2024-11-02T15:02:00Z, window_ceil=2024-11-02T15:03:00Z, tokens=62,300 for proj_42, but aggregator shows proj_42 split across two shards causing double count at the org rollup.
aj: Could be the rolling-window alignment mismatch between realtime aggregator and dashboard. Repro: query realtime ledger for that minute and SUM by shard.
marta: Repro steps I used:
```sql
SELECT shard, window_floor, SUM(tokens) FROM metering.realtime
WHERE org='org_acme' AND ts >= '2024-11-02T15:02:00Z' AND ts < '2024-11-02T15:04:00Z'
GROUP BY 1,2;
```
I saw proj_42 tokens split into two window_floor values due to per-shard floor rounding.
sam: That matches a bug I saw last sprint: shards floor timestamps to local-ish epoch then aggregator re-floors to minute boundaries resulting in overlap for boundary requests. When two shards both count the same token near boundary, org rollup SUM double-counts.
aj: Quick mitigation: routing/rate-limiter should dedupe by request_id at enforcement time for 10s. Can we enable a 10s dedupe window for org enforcement while we fix aggregator?
linda: I can patch rate-limiter to consult recent request_id cache. Low-risk. Will enable feature flag in staging then promote to prod if green.
eng-sre: For root fix we need to change windowing to use consistent floor(ts, '1 second') at ingest across shards and update rollup job to de-duplicate overlapping boundaries. Also add a test that simulates boundary bursts.
marta: Customer-facing note: I'll tell them we identified a transient double-count at minute boundaries leading to temporary org enforcement; advising them it's not billing (invoices unaffected) and tokens were not charged twice. I'll offer a temporary quota raise while we deploy the patch.
aj: Assigning followups: eng-sre -> implement aggregator fix (P0), linda -> enable dedupe flag for org enforcement (P0), sam -> add unit/integration tests for shard boundary cases (P1), marta -> send customer update + temp raise.
eng-sre: ETA for patch and tests: 48 hours. Will post rollout plan and small DB migration steps.
marta: :thumbsup: thanks all — keep me posted. I sent interim note to the customer.
quota-bot: Note added to org_acme incident timeline: double-counting at shard boundaries suspected; temporary dedupe enabled at 15:45 UTC.
